summary: Identify the release archive client explicitly when preseeding pinned Zig packages

replay.detail: No runtime or claim replay changes.

schema.detail: No stored or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Dependency URLs, pinned Zig hashes, retry counts, elapsed deadlines and build failure behavior are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Archive requests use an honest release-client User-Agent rather than Python's generic default, which the archive server can refuse. No browser identity or alternate content is substituted.

manual.detail: The existing release preseed step supplies the request header automatically.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the default request identification. Hash mismatches and exhausted transports retain their existing behavior.
